notes.title: Mischief Patch Notes - 01242025
notes.content:
🐀 Biggest Update Yet! 🐀

This update brings major improvements to Mischief, including a 5x expansion of the adventurable area, the full achievement system in Adventure Mode, and an even more immersive introduction to the world with new opening cutscenes and the debut of the villainous Plague!

[h1]🆕 New in This Update[/h1]
[h2]🌍 Adventure Mode Expansion[/h2]
[list]
[*]The adventurable area is now five times bigger!
[*]More places to explore, objects to interact with, and secrets to uncover.
[*]Enhanced environmental details and new traversal challenges.
[*]Achievements are now available in Adventure Mode (previously only available in boss levels).
[/list]
[h2]🎬 Opening Cutscenes & Story Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The adventure now begins with brand-new opening cutscenes, setting the stage for your mischief-filled journey.
[*] Introducing Plague, the melodramatic, chaotic villain who believes he is the star of his own twisted drama.
[/list]
[h2]🐭 Rat Character Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a new rig that improves movement fluidity and responsiveness.
[/list]
[h2]🎨 Visual & UI Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated UI art to better match the in-game aesthetic, making menus and HUD elements feel more immersive.
[*] Enhanced UI readability, especially in menus and dialog boxes.
[*] Updated lighting, environment effects, and animations for a more polished look.
[/list]
[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Misc. Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in certain objects.
[*] Improved multiplayer sync for smoother co-op gameplay.
[*] Various performance optimizations for better stability.
[/list]
[h2]🐾 Go Cause Some Mischief![/h2]
With a bigger world to explore, achievements to chase, and smoother gameplay, there’s never been a better time to jump in! Let us know what you think in the community forums.

🐀 Tavern Rat Studios

notes.title: Update Notes - 08302024
notes.content:
[b]Heyo RATHEADS![/b] We're excited to bring you a new update packed with fresh features, gameplay enhancements, and important fixes. Here's what's new:[h1]🎖️ New Achievement System - To-Do/To-DONT Lists 🎖️
[/h1]Our most significant update in this patch is the brand-new Achievement System! Track your progress and show off your accomplishments with our freshly implemented achievements. Here’s what you can expect:[list]
[*] [b]Achievement UI:[/b] A sleek new interface to easily view and navigate your achievements.
[*] [b]Achievement Stickers: [/b]Collect stickers as you unlock achievements to commemorate your victories![/list][h1]New Features & Content[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Revive System:[/b] Improved the revive system with a tutorial to guide you through it.
[*] [b]Weapon Regeneration:[/b] Replaced scattered weapons with one of each that reproduce automatically, reducing visual clutter.[/list][h1]Gameplay Enhancements
[/h1][list][*] [b]Boss Battle Difficulty Scaling:[/b] Single-player mode now features difficulty scaling for boss battles to match your skill level.
[*] [b]Mole Health System:[/b] Major rework of the Mole Health System for better balance and gameplay.
[*] [b]Platform Pouncing:[/b] Updated platform pouncing mechanics, including fixes to the circle sticking to feet.
[*] [b]Truck Handling: [/b]Tweaked truck handling for smoother gameplay.
[*] [b]Clamber Update:[/b] Minor updates to clamber mechanics for better movement.
[*] [b]Fix Camera Lerping:[/b] Resolved issues with camera lerping when using the mouse.[/list][h1]User Interface & Experience[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Player Select UI:[/b] Added art flair and improved highlights for better visibility when selecting players.
[*] [b]Resolution Filtering:[/b] Now only shows resolutions that your monitor supports, preventing accidental selection of unsupported options.[/list][h1]Audio Improvements[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Character Select Music: [/b]We've recreated and expanded the character select music for a more immersive experience.
[*] [b]Hot Dog Music: [/b]Added new music tracks for Firepit Fiasco.
[*] [b]Rebalance Sound Effects:[/b] Sound effects have been rebalanced using our new system for an enhanced audio experience.
[*] [b]Rerecorded Mole Sounds: [/b]Mole sounds have been re-recorded for improved audio quality.
[*] [b]Coin Sound Effects:[/b] Updated coin sound effects and added a spinning animation with an offset.[/list][h1]Miscellaneous Improvements[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Particle Replacements:[/b] Updated particles in the weapon select screen for better visuals.[/list]Thank you for playing and for your continued support! We hope you enjoy the latest update and look forward to hearing your feedback.

notes.title: Update Notes - 06072024
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW! Shoot Condiments:[/b] Use condiments available in adventure mode to graffiti the yard and create works of art.
[/list]
[h1]Combat Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW! 3 Jab Combo: [/b]Land 3 attacks consecutively for a damage boost, ending in either a powerful slam or a rapid spin.
[*][b]NEW! Hold to Charge Attack: [/b]Hold the attack button to charge your energy and unleash a variety of impactful attacks
[*]Added a grace period when army men spawn to prevent immediate damage.
[*]Improved Aiming for Keyboards
[*]Rats are now moved to safety during phase changes in fights.
[*]Reduced lag for swingy weapons.
[/list]
[h1]UI Updates
[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW! Title Screen:[/b] The title screen has been reworked into a main menu using a new logo, more stylized buttons, and links to socials. This also allows access to the settings menu before first play. 
[*][b]NEW! Dialog Boxes:[/b] Dialog boxes now represent fortune cookie fortunes with handcrafted images and signatures from each of the rats
[*][b]NEW! Level Selector: [/b]Level selector now has new art where images are displayed on tape measure. 
[*]Added arrow key navigation in UI systems.
[*]Adjusted P3/P4 weapon UI to prevent overlapping with boss health bars and made health bars skinnier.
[*]Fixed an issue where the settings menu would not open with a controller on the title screen in the Steam build.
[*]Moved the adventure mode entry away from the rat hole to the middle of the grass to prevent accidental reentry 
[/list]
[h1]Movement/Control Updates
[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]NEW! Force Based Movement System[/b]
[*]Auto-aim feature for double jumps.
[*]Enhanced drop shadow effects.
[*]Improved the landing circle to lerp back to the player and reduced jitteriness.
[*]Reduced turning speed when characters are standing still.
[*]Prevented soft locking when players lack a second jump.
[/list]
[h1]Truck/Racing Improvements:
[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved overall control and aerial control on trucks.
[*]Revisited and adjusted the camera for trucks.
[*]Implemented a new suspension system for trucks
[*]Replaced the cheese section of the track.
[/list]

[h1]Other Bug Fixes and Adjustments
[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased the size of rats for better visibility and gameplay.
[*]Changed the Platform Pouncing Floor to improve visual clarity 
[*]Centered the spotlight over the rake.
[*]Fixed an issue where some pigs in the shooting gallery would appear on the bottom right corner and disappear.
[*]Prevented movement of the rat when entering high score in solo platform pouncing mode.
[*]Fixed the camera moving away from the sandbox during the opening yard cutscene.
[*]Added missing collider on the bottom of the slide in the playscape.
[*]Fixed the fireplace collider from mesh to box collider.
[*]Prevented Shovul from targeting dead rats. Forced targeting to shuffle to avoid re-targeting the same rat.
[*]Updated the player select prompt from "press start" to a more inclusive instruction for all controllers.
[*]Fixed an issue where characters would spin and get stuck in the air during death.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and providing feedback! Your input helps us make the game better for everyone. Enjoy the updates and happy gaming!
